$comment: Curated from https://github.com/mnfst/awesome-free-llm-apis — OpenAI-compatible free tiers for AAROHI brains. Prefer built-in Gemini/Groq/OpenRouter cards when listed; otherwise use Models → OpenAI Compatible with base_url + key.

aarohi_wiring.usage_order: MAIN + fallbacks in Models; Claude/Codex deny → next provider
aarohi_wiring.auto_default: On Vercel (or when no cloud keys), apply_model_env seeds FREE_LLM_PRESET=llm7 → openai-compat so chat always has a brain
aarohi_wiring.local_only: ollama-local requires PC Ollama; not reachable from Vercel

notes: Stack as many keys as you have; AAROHI walks usage order. Without keys, llm7 anonymous openai-compat is the always-on free brain.

presets.label: Groq (free tier)
presets.notes: Ultra-fast. Use the built-in Groq card on Models.

presets.label: Google Gemini (free tier)
presets.notes: Use the built-in Google Gemini (API) card on Models.

presets.label: OpenRouter free pool
presets.notes: Best general fallback when Claude/Codex deny. Set OPENROUTER_API_KEY.

presets.label: LLM7.io (free / anonymous)
presets.notes: Anonymous works with empty key for turbo models; free token raises limits.

presets.label: Aion Labs (roleplay / storytelling)
presets.notes: 15 RPM / 20K TPD free. Good sweet-girl persona companion models.

presets.label: Mistral AI (free mode)
presets.notes: Wire via OpenAI Compatible card with this base URL + API key.

presets.label: Z AI / Zhipu GLM Flash (free)
presets.notes: 1 concurrent free request. Use OpenAI Compatible.

presets.label: Ollama (local, free)
presets.notes: Must be running on your PC. Vercel cloud cannot reach your localhost Ollama — use local AAROHI or a tunnel.
